title: Combustion, Fire and Flames
summary: Burning is a reaction with oxygen. Learn the fire triangle, ignition temperature, types of combustion and the three zones of a candle flame.

cbse.chapter: Previous NCERT edition: Combustion and Flame (check its place in Curiosity)
Curiosity Ch 5: Changes Around Us (burning as a chemical change)

objectives: I can define combustion and name its products for fuels containing carbon.
I can explain the fire triangle and use it to explain how fires are put out.
I can explain ignition temperature and distinguish rapid, spontaneous and explosive combustion.
I can describe the three zones of a candle flame.
misconceptions: The yellow part of a flame is the hottest.
Anything will burn if you heat it enough in any conditions (oxygen is also needed).
